criteria.evidence_policy: Persist the frozen workload manifest, every sanitized terminal attempt record, calculation inputs, execution identity, and SHA-256 digests.
criteria.normalized_claim: Across 100 measured streaming attempts with configured client concurrency set to four, client-observed p95 time to first non-empty content is below 500 milliseconds and attempted-request error rate is below 1%.

source.quote: At concurrency four, p95 time to first token must stay below 500 milliseconds and the request error rate must stay below one percent.
source.speaker: customer_vp_engineering

criteria.title: Inference latency and reliability

evidence_retention_policy: The approved synthetic prompt fixture may be retained; no secrets, response text, or raw customer data may enter evidence artifacts.
non_goals: This 100-request engineering run does not prove achieved four-way request overlap, production capacity, GPU execution latency, model quality, or long-duration reliability.
use_case: Prove that one OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint meets the agreed streaming latency and reliability target.
